halal_safeguards.default: Flag financing, interest, yield, leverage, margin, derivatives and trading structures for review before consideration.
halal_safeguards.evidence_rule: A reviewed_with_advisory_source entry requires a source reference and reviewer notes. This register does not certify religious permissibility.
halal_safeguards.shafii_attention: Escalate uncertain contracts and financial structures for qualified Shafi'i review; do not present automated classifications as a fatwa.

rules: CAD 0 is the default incremental spend ceiling until sustainable revenue and explicit owner approval.
Estimates are planning data, not commitments or cash outflows.
Positive approved, committed or paid amounts require a non-zero owner-approved spend ceiling and approval reference.
Paid amounts require proof reference and cannot exceed the approved or committed amount.
Only paid, received or settled revenue ledger rows count as cash received; ledger records are not independently verified bank balances.
Unknown currencies are not converted or added to CAD totals without a documented exchange-rate source.
No borrowing, yield, leverage, wallet action or live trade is authorised by this policy.
